accept_eula.description: Must be true: acceptance of the Minecraft EULA.

loader.description: Paper, Purpur, Spigot, Folia, Fabric, Forge, NeoForge, Vanilla, Velocity...

version.description: Minecraft version, latest release when null.

active.description: True for the server that owns the public port.

errors.description: Last ERROR lines of the log.

error.description: Set when the folder or config.json is unusable; the fields below are then absent.

port_holder.description: Foreign process holding the port of a stopped server.

sleep_listener.description: Sleeping server: the daemon holds the port.

stop_reason.description: Reason recorded by the last stop.

allow.description: Extra player names allowed to wake the server.

outside_service.description: True when the JVM was started outside the daemon cgroup.

force.description: Kill instead of a clean stop.

start.description: Result of starting the incoming server.

get.description: Unauthenticated; used by clients to check compatibility.
Same content as `mc status --json`, with `ok` and `code` added.

post.description: Result of the job: DeployResult (`deployed`). Refused with `eula_required`, `folder_not_empty`, `port_taken`, `unknown_loader`, `invalid_ram`.

202.description: Operation accepted; follow it on the job.

delete.description: Removes the server from the registry; the folder, worlds and backups are never deleted.

get.summary: Detail and state of one server

post.summary: Mark a server active without starting it

expires.description: Epoch seconds of the automatic thaw.

get.summary: Last lines of the daemon log for a server

post.description: Stop then start through the daemon (same path as a scheduled restart). Job result code: task_restart_done.

202.description: Operation accepted; follow it on the job.

post.description: Clears a crash-loop marker and starts the server explicitly in that case; otherwise the daemon restarts it on its next tick.
post.summary: Leave maintenance and hand the server back to the daemon

put.description: `schedule_same_time` (422) when opening and closing are equal. Switches the server to schedule mode.

post.description: Does not touch the maintenance flag. `already_running` is a success.
Waits for the JVM to exit. Sets the maintenance flag and records the reason. `already_stopped` is a success.
post.summary: Stop a server and enter maintenance

post.description: Swaps game and RCON ports with the active server. Job result: SwitchResult. Refused with `players_online` (409) unless forced.

202.description: Operation accepted; follow it on the job.

post.summary: Make this server the active one

post.description: Job result: UpgradeResult. Backs the world up first. Refused with `server_running`, `downgrade_refused`, `loader_unavailable`, `source_unreachable`.

202.description: Operation accepted; follow it on the job.
